subject: english
title: Prefixes un-, dis- and re-
canDo: I can add un-, dis- or re- to a word to change what it means.

subject: english
title: Suffixes -ful, -less and -ly
canDo: I can add -ful, -less or -ly to a word and spell the new word correctly.

subject: english
title: Comparing with -er and -est
canDo: I can add -er and -est to compare things and spell the words correctly.

subject: english
title: Plurals with -s, -es and -ies
canDo: I can spell plurals by adding -s or -es, or by changing y to -ies.

subject: english
title: Alphabetical and dictionary order
titleId: Urutan alfabet dan mencari kata di kamus
canDo: I can put words in alphabetical order and use guide words to find a word in a dictionary.

subject: english
title: Past, present and future
canDo: I can choose verbs that show if something happened, is happening or will happen.

subject: english
title: Homophones
canDo: I can choose the right spelling for words that sound the same but mean different things.

subject: english
title: Synonyms and antonyms
canDo: I can find words that mean the same and words that mean the opposite.

subject: english
title: Joining ideas with conjunctions
canDo: I can join ideas with and, but, or, so, because, when and if.

subject: english
title: Speech marks
canDo: I can put speech marks around the words a character says.

subject: english
title: Main idea and key details
canDo: I can say what a text is mostly about and find key details in it.

subject: english
title: Reading between the lines
canDo: I can use clues in a text to work out feelings, reasons and word meanings.

subject: english
title: How different texts are organised
titleId: Ciri dan susunan berbagai jenis teks
canDo: I can spot the features of stories, poems, playscripts, letters, instructions and reports.

subject: english
title: Writing a story
titleId: Menulis cerita dengan awal, tengah, dan akhir
canDo: I can write a story with a beginning, a middle with a problem, and an end.

subject: english
title: Speaking and presenting
titleId: Berbicara dan presentasi di depan kelompok
canDo: I can speak clearly to a group, explain my ideas in order and answer questions.
